contexts.text: Genuine pleasures originate thence.
Now in the genuine, now in the opposite sense.

Goods and truths not genuine but apparent had possession of (the external man) from which he had fought against so many enemies... (The internal man) then flowed in... and thus purified him, so that his goods and truths were no longer apparent, but genuine goods and truths...
He is called a brother's son when possessed by apparent goods and truths; but a brother, when possessed by genuine goods and genuine truths.
How, after the combats of temptations, apparent goods become genuine goods... Signified.
The Rational is as... a genuine son when it is formed from truths which are adjoined to goods... It is also before acknowledged as a son, but not as a genuine one, but as being from a maidservant...
Genuine visions. Described.
In proportion as the truths with man are more genuine, the Divine which flows in is more perfectly received...
Genuine marriage love. Described. AC 2740. AC 2758.

The genuine affections of truth and good which are perceived by man, are all from a Divine origin... but as they descend... they flow into affections not genuine and spurious... and so are varied. In external form they present themselves like genuine ones. The end is the single mark by which they are Known; if from end they are for the sake of self and the world, these affections are not genuine; but if from end they are for the sake of the good of the neighbour, etc., they are genuine ones; for then they are for the sake of the Lord...
If he perceives this delight he is in genuine affection.
The reason the end determines whether the affection is genuine, spurious, or false. Explained.
This good... is of use only to introduce genuine truths and goods... This is like fruits (which at last) ripen by fibres of genuine juice.
So during regeneration, man is led by many affections of good and truth which are not affections of genuine good and truth...
With man, even within the Church, there are few genuine truths... Hence affections of genuine truth are rare...
Where the Divine is, all things are disposed into order, so that they can be conjoined with genuine goods and genuine truths which are in the Heavens...
The good of love to God, and the good of charity towards the neighbour, however various the truths and affections of truth may be, are still receptible of genuine truth and good...

Forby Laban is signified such good as is not genuine; because genuine truths have not been implanted in it; but still it is such that they can be conjoined with it... It is wont to exist with little children before they have received genuine truths; and also with the simple... and also with upright gentiles... By such good, genuine truths and goods can be introduced... AC 4063. AC 4063:2. AC 4145:2.
Divine good cannot be applied to any vessels but genuine truths.
Camp, in a good sense, = genuine order; and in the opposite sense, order not genuine.
When good takes the prior place, the Natural is enlightened, and therein it is seen what is genuine truth and good, and what is not genuine.
The genuine Conjugial. Signified.
For everything genuine is at the same time internal.
For in order that truth may be genuine it must derive its essence and life from charity, and this latter, from innocence.

Combat can also be waged from truth not genuine, provided it is such that it can in some way be conjoined with good... Hence those within the Church can be regenerated through any doctrine; but those more than others who are in genuine truths.
The genuine and the opposite sense.

This is called conscience, and is the spiritual life of man, which is to be estimated in proportion as the truths from which he thinks are genuine truths of faith, and in proportion as the goods from which he acts are genuine goods of charity.
Much mixed multitude = goods and truths which are not genuine... For the sons of Israel = genuine goods and truths...

These have genuine goods and truths, and goods and truths not genuine; for the man of the Spiritual Church has no perception of good and truth but he acknowledges as good and truth what the doctrinal things of his Church teach. Hence he is in very many truths not genuine, consequently also in the like goods; for goods have their quality from truths. References... But still they are kept by the Lord in truths in the highest degree genuine, which is done by an influx through the interiors; and then the truths and goods not genuine are separated thence, and are rejected to the sides.
See Gentile.

For truths and goods not genuine are indeed separated from the genuine goods and truths with the spiritual man, but they are not taken away; they remain adjoined at the side to which they are rejected. (So) with the Lord's Church among the gentiles, who have not genuine truths. These, moreover, in Heaven are adjoined to those who are in genuine truths and goods.
There is no perception from Heaven, except with those who are in the love of truth from good, and not even then, unless they are in the love of truth from genuine good.

The genuine affection of truth... and the affection of truth which is not genuine. Defined. Signified... (Such) do not care whether the truths they know are genuine... But they who are in the genuine affection of truth... Without searching the Scripture from the genuine affection of truth, they would have remained in those heresies...
The genuine truth of the doctrine of the Church. Defined.
What the genuine doctrine of the Church teaches...
Good not genuine and truth not genuine with those who are outside the Church. Signified.
Hence it is that their truth of faith is not genuine, nor their good of charity...
With the good which lies inwardly concealed in genuine truths, or in truths not genuine... the case is like... AC 9258:3. Explained.
Although these are not genuine truths, still they are accepted as genuine...
To teach truths not genuine. Signified.

If that in which they are enlightened is the genuine truth of faith, and if that in which they are enkindled is the genuine good of charity, then it is the Intellectual of the internal man which is enlightened, and the Voluntary of the internal man which is enkindled. It is otherwise if it is not the genuine truth of faith or the genuine good of charity...
Genuine, and clearly seen. Signified.
Pure, when predicated of the good which is signified by oil, = genuine; for the more celestial good is, thus the more genuine it is, the purer it is.
The genuine truths and goods of faith and love exist only with those (who are of the Church); for with them is the Word.
Then the good of love is genuine; otherwise it is spurious...
Only those who are enlightened apprehend the genuine sense of the Word...
The genuine doctrine of the Church is the doctrine of charity and of faith together...

Those whose intelligence and wisdom have been formed from genuine truths and goods, have communication with Societies according to the form of Heaven; but with those whose intelligence and wisdom have not been formed from genuine truths and goods, and yet from such things as agree, the communication is broken, and is coherent in diverse ways...
The innocency of infancy... is not genuine innocence...
The innocence of wisdom is genuine innocence...
From this comes the genuine affection of truth, which is the affection of truth for the sake of truth...
Marriage love is genuine in proportion as the truths which are conjoined with the good are genuine.
Genuine marriage love exists in the Inmost Heaven...
Genuine charity and genuine faith are devoid of all merit...
When man is led by the Lord, he is introduced into the genuine truths which are to be implanted in the understanding, and into the genuine goods which are to be implanted in the will...
Unless the genuine doctrine of the Church shines on the sense of the letter...
The doctrine of genuine truth has now been revealed...
That genuine truth... in the sense of the letter, appears only to those who are in enlightenment from the Lord.
That neither were the genuine truths in which is the spiritual sense... revealed... until after the Last Judgment...
The faith of genuine truth, and the faith of the appearances of truth.
Whether the good deeds are from charity... genuine, or spurious.
They who have genuine charity...
(This) is genuine love towards the neighbour.
Doctrine (is) useful if from genuine truths...
(This) is spurious charity... (This) is genuine charity.
Genuine charity, which is living, is that only which makes one with faith...
The New Church... in which genuine truths are taught...
(Then) the appearances of truth... are turned into genuine truths. Enumerated.
And when there is not any genuine truth, there can be no genuine good...
Not a single genuine truth is left in the Church.
That in the coming Church there would not be a genuine truth. (Signified by the vinegar given to the Lord.)
They who live in evil... have scarcely any genuine truth... If the sense of the letter is not viewed from genuine truths, it... is falsified.
It was found that such persons do not know or acknowledge a single genuine truth.
Then, in proportion as his faith is from genuine truths, he enters Heaven...
Still, as they are not in genuine truths, although they do not shut Heaven against themselves, they cannot advance beyond its threshold...
